data.narrative:
LabGenius, a Seed-stage biotech company founded by James Field, has raised $73M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised as a proxy baseline ($27M), and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to subsequent stages, the method implies a valuation of $68M. This reflects the step-up calibrated against conventional Series A entry multiples in the biotech sector.

The peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables meeting screening thresholds. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (7.4x median across the three public tickers) is not actionable absent disclosed revenue. The analysis therefore relies on a single method, limiting triangulation robustness.

The supported valuation range is $57M to $78M, with a median point estimate of $68M. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, limited peer overlap at the Seed stage, and reliance on raised capital as a valuation proxy rather than fundamental metrics. Additional information on capital deployment, burn rate, and technical milestones would sharpen conviction.
